critical_code_review_comments: AddProjectWizard.jsx line 544: step-2 container uses data-testid='wizard-step-3' — a legacy testid left over from when this was step 3 of a 3-step wizard. Confusing after the 3→2 restructure. Suggest renaming to 'wizard-step-2' (and any dependent unit tests) for clarity. Not functional bug — flows work — just tech-debt cosmetics.
